The '''Experimental Shockwave Device''' was a type of [[Concussion grenade/Legends|concussion grenade]] produced by [[Wynz-Tek/Legends|Wynz-Tek]]. During the [[battle for the Black Hole]], the [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] criminal [[Kovic]] used a variety of Wynz-Tek grenades, including Experimental Shockwave Devices, in battle.
